transformations.rationale: Adapted the inherent `&mut self` receiver to the explicit harness receiver `slice: &mut [T]`; no target semantics were changed.

Represented Rust's `let slice: *mut [T] = self` raw-provenance step with `rust_1_96_slice_receiver_to_raw`, preserving the non-mutating frame fact while avoiding direct Verus raw slice-pointer modeling.

Represented the `MaybeUninit<[&mut I::Output; N]>::uninit()` and `arr.as_mut_ptr()` setup with local token boundaries because Verus does not model MaybeUninit raw storage for mutable-reference arrays directly.

Isolated the unsafe source loop over `0..N`, unchecked index cloning, unchecked mutable slice indexing, raw `cast/add/write`, and final `arr.assume_init()` in one named boundary guarded by the generated disjoint/in-bounds precondition.
